support_locator: public discussion of truck-pack diagrams, numbered cases and pack order
paraphrase_notes: Corroborates that deliberate truck-pack sequencing and case identifiers are real production practices.
applicability_notes: Community evidence; exact load plan, numbering and responsibilities vary by production/company.
required_qualifier: Follow the current responsible loader/lead and load plan; do not teach one universal truck-pack scheme.

support_locator: public discussion describing entry local-hand load-in/load-out movement
paraphrase_notes: Corroborates that early local-hand work commonly includes moving production gear between truck and venue under direction.
applicability_notes: Community pattern only; department and production practice vary.
required_qualifier: Assigned support only; actual truck-pack control stays with the responsible production/loading role.

support_locator: public discussion of checklists and case content lists
paraphrase_notes: Corroborates documentation, labels and case-content organization as practical production prep/load-control tools.
required_qualifier: Treat labels and lists as production-specific control information, not universal industry coding.

support_locator: FMCSA regulatory guidance distinguishing physical loading work from driver's continuing responsibilities
paraphrase_notes: Supports separating a helper's physical participation from the covered driver's continuing regulatory responsibilities.
applicability_notes: Applies only where the cited federal CMV rule applies; not every event trailer/private-property move is covered.
required_qualifier: Where federal CMV rules apply, driver/motor-carrier responsibilities remain separate from helper support.

support_locator: public discussion of common live-production cable/connector families and compatibility corrections
paraphrase_notes: Corroborates that connector-family recognition is ordinary production vocabulary and that similarly described families can have important compatibility differences.
applicability_notes: Community evidence only; exact connector facts require manufacturer/official documentation before final learner wording.
required_qualifier: Recognition only; do not infer function or compatibility from appearance alone.

support_locator: public discussion noting identical/similar connector shells can carry different signals/functions
paraphrase_notes: Corroborates stop/ask behavior and the need not to equate connector shape with safe/appropriate use.
applicability_notes: Community evidence; final technical facts must be model/manufacturer/department scoped.
required_qualifier: Use labels and current department direction; stop rather than force or guess.

support_locator: qualified-person restrictions for covered work on non-deenergized electrical parts/equipment
paraphrase_notes: Supports preserving a firm boundary between general connector recognition and qualified electrical work on covered energized equipment.
applicability_notes: OSHA Subpart S scope applies only in covered contexts; this edge does not define every department's patch/configuration authority.
required_qualifier: Recognition does not create qualified-person or energized-work authority.
